label: StudySIM1b-hosttax Steps 0-3: what the KV-HOST episodic slowdown is, computed from committed per-request records only. CPU only; no GPU, no model server, no inference; nothing is simulated in this file.

recall_t_end_identity.rule: t_end = t_submit + latency_s within 1.5 ms (three millisecond-rounded fields)

interleaving.rule: in every mixed cell the episodic and recall submit spans overlap on one clock

step1.label: STEP 1 - MODE COST from HELD-OUT cells (StudyE10b KVHOST k=0 vs KVGPU k=0; neither appears in any StudySIM1 gate cell)
step1.noise_floor_rule: per-N drift between StudyE10b and StudyE10c on the same configuration at 25 % load; the other load levels are reported beside it

step2.label: STEP 2 - OVERLAP COST in every KV-HOST k > 0 cell, with KV-GPU k in {2,4} as the control (no collapse there)

regression.model: ttft_s ~ 1 + overlap + n_concurrent + cached_ktokens + new_ktokens + load_fraction, OLS on every KV-HOST k > 0 episodic request not overlapping a cold recall; CIs from 200 bootstrap refits (requests resampled)
